reviewCadence: At every login, MFA, bot guard, proof-of-work, rate-limit, exposed-credential, risk scoring, session, or authentication telemetry change.

requirements.name: Use multi-factor authentication and step-up
requirements.owasp: MFA is the strongest practical defense against credential stuffing and password spraying.

controls.name: Risk-triggered MFA challenge and step-up
controls.description: Sensitive operations and elevated risk trigger MFA and step-up requirements.

requirements.name: Detect credential stuffing and password spraying patterns
requirements.owasp: Track login volume and anomalies using domain rules and risk signals.

controls.name: Trust-Risk assessment and signal evaluation
controls.description: Trust-Risk service evaluates risk signals and applies rules to classify suspicious traffic.

requirements.name: Limit authentication attempts across dimensions
requirements.owasp: Use layered rate limits for accounts, IPs, and short bursts.

controls.name: PostgreSQL rate limiter
controls.description: Rate limiting evaluates actions, keys, windows, and maximum hits atomically against PostgreSQL.

requirements.name: Prevent account enumeration and timing side-channels
requirements.owasp: Do not reveal whether an account exists, and preserve identical response timing.

controls.name: Dummy verify and normalized errors
controls.description: Authenticate runs dummy Argon2id verification when accounts are missing and returns generic errors.

requirements.name: Enforce strong password policy and hashing
requirements.owasp: Require strong passwords and hash with memory-hard Argon2id.

controls.name: Argon2id hashing with pepper and length bounds
controls.description: Passwords require bounded lengths, zxcvbn strength, and Argon2id hashing with pepper.

requirements.name: Capture device and client IP context
requirements.owasp: Determine true client IP behind trusted proxies and request Client Hints.

controls.name: Client IP validation and Client Hints
controls.description: Secure proxy-aware IP resolution and Client Hints headers identify client execution context.

requirements.name: Monitor and audit authentication traffic
requirements.owasp: Record structured audit events for investigation and alerting.

controls.name: Transactional audit logging
controls.description: Audit records capture login attempts, synthetic identities, password resets, and principal creation.

requirements.name: Prevent regressions
requirements.owasp: Credential stuffing controls must stay enforced as authentication code evolves.

controls.name: Credential stuffing prevention gate
controls.description: Automated verification ensures all OWASP controls, rate limiters, password hashing, and audit trails remain intact.
